name: Workflow connectors (block catalogue)
description: Reusable managed workflow connections with write-only OpenBao credentials. External actions default to Simulation; Real requires a selected connection and explicit confirmation. Legacy credential settings are no longer accepted. Demo sheet remains simulated.

settings.label: HTTP block: allowed hosts
settings.help: Exact destination host names this block may call. Empty refuses all outbound calls. Redirects are not followed. Only add hosts you trust; local/private hosts expose local services.
